description: This file defines the application's routing configuration using the go_router package for a Flutter healthcare app. It sets up route paths, navigation logic, authentication guards, and the main structure of the app's navigation including a shell route with bottom tabs and placeholder screens.

classes.description: A singleton class that configures and manages app routing, including route definitions, navigation methods, and redirect guards based on authentication status.
